name: The Ghost and Molly McGee
description: When a curse from Scratch backfires, he finds himself forever bound to Molly. Despite that, Scratch and Molly form an unlikely friendship that guides each of them through the ups and downs of their respective worlds!

videos.title: The Curse
videos.overview: When the McGee family moves into a new house, Molly stumbles upon Scratch, a grumpy old ghost.

videos.title: First Day Frights
videos.overview: Thanks to Scratch, Molly struggles to make a good impression at school.

videos.title: Howlin' Harriet
videos.overview: Molly attends a camping trip to answer the important question of who her best friends will be

videos.title: The Unnatural
videos.overview: Scratch teaches Molly's softball team what it feels like to win.

videos.title: Getting the Band(shell) Back Together
videos.overview: When Molly learns about Brighton’s old outdoor concert Bandshell, she sets out to rebuild it to bring the community together.

videos.title: The Greatest Concert Ever
videos.overview: Molly must find a band to play the first concert at Brighton’s new Bandshell.

videos.title: Mama’s Gotta Hustle
videos.overview: When the McGee’s van breaks down and the repair costs are more than they can afford, Molly’s mom decides to take on odd jobs to help the family make ends meet.

videos.title: Hooray for Mollywood!
videos.overview: Molly learns that more money means more problems when she teams up with Andrea to create a scary movie.

videos.title: Not So Honest Abe
videos.overview: Molly only has a few hours to put together an entire school project on Abraham Lincoln, but it’s helpful that Scratch knows Abraham Lincoln’s ghost.

videos.title: The Best of Nin-tensions
videos.overview: Molly senses tension between her mom and grandma Nin, so she takes it upon herself to identify the source of the conflict and mend the rift.

videos.title: Mazel Tov, Libby!
videos.overview: When Molly discovers her best friend didn’t even go close to big on the biggest day of life, Molly takes charge to throw Libby the best Bat Mitzvah ever.

videos.title: No Good Deed
videos.overview: When Darryl gets in trouble at school, Molly volunteers to help reform his delinquent ways by giving him 'nice lessons'.

videos.title: The Turnip Twist
videos.overview: Pete and Molly put a Turnip Fest to win Best Fest of the midwest over Brighton's rival town: Perfektborg.

videos.title: All Systems No
videos.overview: For one day, Molly can only say "yes" and Scratch can only say "no".

videos.title: Monumental Disaster
videos.overview: When Molly meets Brighton’s legendary founder, Ezekial Tugbottom, she realizes he’s not the hero history made him out to be.

videos.title: Talent Show
videos.overview: Molly tries to prevent Libby from humiliating herself in the school talent show without shattering her newfound confidence.

videos.title: Scratch the Surface
videos.overview: When constantly lying to Libby about Scratch begins to take a toll, Molly struggles to keep Scratch a secret.

videos.title: Friend-Off
videos.overview: When Libby and Scratch struggle to be friends with each other, Molly sends them on a scavenger hunt in an attempt to force their friendship.

videos.title: Festival of Lights
videos.overview: When a town-wide blackout occurs on the final night of Hanukkah, the people of Brighton seek refuge in Libby’s mom’s bookstore, the only place in town with light.

videos.title: Saving Christmas
videos.overview: Molly tries to convince Andrea’s father to save Christmas after budget cuts leave Brighton without its beloved Snowflake Festival.

videos.title: Ice Princess
videos.overview: When a ghost causes an ice storm in Brighton, only Dad can save the town from eternal winter.

videos.title: Ready, Set, Snow!
videos.overview: When Molly gets her first snow day, she struggles to give up on her perfect vision.

videos.title: Game Night
videos.overview: The McGees lets competition get the best of them during family game night.

videos.title: The Don't-Gooder
videos.overview: When Andrea steals credit for Molly’s volunteer work, Molly tries to expose her.

videos.title: Innocent Until Proven Ghostly
videos.overview: Molly tries to prove Scratch’s innocence when he’s falsely accused of a crime.

videos.title: Twin Trouble
videos.overview: Dad struggles to stay true to himself when his twin siblings come to visit.

videos.title: Goat Your Own Way
videos.overview: When Molly insists on training her unruly goat for the county fair the “Molly way,” she learns that positive reinforcement doesn’t always yield positive results.

videos.title: A Very Hungry Ghost
videos.overview: When the McGee’s celebrate a Thai holiday about feeding “hungry ghosts,” Scratch tries to keep the feast all to himself.

videos.title: Scare Tactics
videos.overview: After Scratch ditches class in favor of a fun day off with Geoff, he struggles to pass his scare test.

videos.title: The Bad Boy Bobby Daniels
videos.overview: When Molly and Scratch learn about Patty’s old flame, Bobby Daniels, they attempt to reunite the lovebirds.

videos.title: Citizen McGee
videos.overview: When Molly’s "Mayor for a Day" contest win turns into a "Mayor for Life" gig, she struggles under the pressure.

videos.title: The Internship
videos.overview: When Molly interns at Weird Larry’s Pawn Show, she struggles to see the bright side in a shop full of discarded junk.

videos.title: The Lucky Penny
videos.overview: Molly and Scratch help Libby improve her luck on Friday the 13th.

videos.title: Lock, Stock, and Peril
videos.overview: When the McGee’s get locked in the basement, Molly and Scratch seek help, but have trouble remaining focused.

videos.title: Out of House and Home
videos.overview: he McGee’s struggle to make ends meet after a hospital trip leaves them nearly broke.

videos.title: Home is Where the Haunt Is
videos.overview: Molly does her best to pretend everything is normal while Scratch protects the house.

videos.title: Scaring is Caring
videos.overview: Molly takes over Scratch’s scares for the day.

videos.title: All Night Plight
videos.overview: Molly, Scratch, and Libby try to stay up to see a rare comet.

videos.title: The Jig is Up
videos.overview: When the Ghost Council discovers joy in Brighton, Scratch must keep Molly out of harm’s way.

videos.title: Molly vs. the Ghost World
videos.overview: When Scratch is taken to the Ghost World for trial, Molly sets out to save him.

videos.title: The New (Para)Normal
videos.overview: When a new family moves in across the street, the McGees are put in a sticky situation. Scratch avoids his duties in the Ghost World.

videos.title: Book Marks the Sprite
videos.overview: Molly must distract Ollie while Scratch attempts to capture the Story Sprite.

videos.title: Double, Double, Darryl & Trouble
videos.overview: Darryl becomes a ghost for the day.

videos.title: Faint of Art
videos.overview: When Sharon has artist's block, Molly and the family remove all of her distractions.

videos.title: A Soda to Remember
videos.overview: When Scratch recalls a rare soda from his past life, Molly is determined to get it for him.

videos.title: A Period Piece
videos.overview: When Libby gets her period before Molly does, Molly feels out of sync with her best friend.

videos.title: It's Always Sunny in Sunnyland
videos.overview: When the McGee's vacation gets canceled, Molly creates a staycation instead.

videos.title: I Wanna Dance with Some-Ollie
videos.overview: Molly's loyalties are tested when she goes to a school dance with Ollie.

videos.title: Davenport's on Demand
videos.overview: When Andrea makes an app that threatens small businesses, Molly and Scratch must save the day.

videos.title: A Doll to Die For
videos.overview: When a scary ghost possesses a doll in the human world, Molly is determined to see the good in him

videos.title: The After Life of The Party
videos.overview: When Scratch is invited to a cool party, he has to ditch his plans with Geoff.

videos.title: Frightmare on Main Street
videos.overview: Scratch invites real ghosts to a Halloween “haunted house” to amp up the fun, but things spiral out of control when the Chens and a horde of Frightmares show up.

videos.title: The Unhaunting of Brighton Video
videos.overview: Molly and Scratch attempt to un-haunt a building for the new community center.

videos.title: 100% Molly McGee
videos.overview: When Molly’s Thai cousin visits, Molly questions whether she is “Asian enough” for her own family.

videos.title: All Shark, No Bite
videos.overview: With Mom and Dad out of the house, Molly, Darryl and Scratch watch a scary movie.

videos.title: Nin-Dependence
videos.overview: When Grandma Nin is no longer able to live on her own, Molly and Sharon take care of her.

videos.title: Like Father, Like Libby
videos.overview: Libby and her mom go on a road trip to visit her dad, who she hasn’t seen in years.

videos.title: Dance Dad Revolution
videos.overview: Pete uses social media to bring attention to important issues but gets swept up in internet fame.

videos.title: Jinx!
videos.overview: When Jinx jinxes Scratch, he and Molly must find a way to undo it.

videos.title: Let's Play Turnipball!
videos.overview: Molly vows to score Brighton’s first win against Perfektborg.

videos.title: The Ghost Is Molly McGee
videos.overview: Molly and Scratch agree to a body swap when they are forced to deal with their own discomfort with feelings.

videos.title: All in the Mind
videos.overview: When Scratch breaks out in a bad case of bubbles, he and Molly take a surreal journey into his mind to find a cure.

videos.title: Carbon Zero Heroes
videos.overview: When Molly and Ollie decide to embrace a carbon-zero lifestyle, they realize it’s harder than it seems.

videos.title: Davenport's in Demise
videos.overview: When Davenport’s closes, Andrea must figure out who she is without her family’s store.

videos.title: Web of Lies
videos.overview: Molly and Scratch spiral with guilt when they think they’ve killed Darryl’s spider.

videos.title: Kenny's Falling Star
videos.overview: When Kenny Star escapes to Brighton, Molly helps him reconnect to his country roots.

videos.title: Welcome to Necrocomic-Con
videos.overview: Ollie struggles to have the difficult conversation with his parents and reveal that he is friends with a ghost.

videos.title: Fit to Print
videos.overview: When the school newspaper is in danger of shutting down, Molly goes on a mission to save it.

videos.title: Smile Valley Farm
videos.overview: When Scratch discovers he loves a game he stubbornly refused to try, he must try to hide his growing obsession.

videos.title: The Grand Gesture
videos.overview: June and Darryl accidentally transform Scratch’s ectoplasm into a living being.

videos.title: The Many Lives of Scratch
videos.overview: Scratch’s family and friends imagine what his life might have been.

videos.title: Alaka-Sham!
videos.overview: Darryl and Scratch run a magic show scheme and are challenged to a magic-off by a rival magician.

videos.title: F.O.N.A.A.!
videos.overview: Scratch uses a curse to take away Molly’s fear.

videos.title: Game On
videos.overview: When Principal O’Connor makes Darryl join a team sport, Darryl creates an esports team.

videos.title: White Christmess
videos.overview: Scratch stresses about getting Molly the perfect gift, while Molly crafts a winter wonderland for the seniors.

videos.title: Perfect Day
videos.overview: Determined to have the perfect day, Molly asks Scratch to cast a time-loop curse so she can fix every mistake when her day keeps going wrong.

videos.title: Jinx vs. the Human World
videos.overview: Molly and Scratch must find a way to stop Jinx from taking over the human world.

videos.title: The End
videos.overview: A flood of lost memories forces Scratch to make big decisions about his afterlife.
